environment.description: Application deployed identically but fronted by CloudFront distribution with Lambda@Edge viewer-request function (ARN: arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:XXXX:function:cf-request-normalizer) that performs URI and query-string canonicalization before forwarding to origin ALB. The ALB has a listener rule at priority 50 that evaluates requests against a custom WAF WebACL. The WebACL contains three rule groups evaluated in order: (1) a custom rule group 'corp-query-param-length' with action BLOCK that limits any single query parameter value to 64 bytes, (2) AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only, and (3) a custom regex-match rule 'dept-param-pattern' that applies a regex pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]{1,32}$ to the query string parameter named 'dept' with BLOCK action on non-match. Origin ALB is in a private subnet accessible only from CloudFront via a prefix list security group rule.

config.cdn: CloudFront with Lambda@Edge viewer-request for canonicalization
config.waf_rule_1: corp-query-param-length: BLOCK if any query param value > 64 bytes
config.waf_rule_2: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet: SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING in COUNT mode (not blocking)
config.waf_rule_3: dept-param-pattern: regex ^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]{1,32}$ on 'dept' param, BLOCK on non-match
config.alb: internal ALB, private subnet, SG allows only CloudFront prefix list
config.network: private subnet, no direct internet access to origin
